map.平方根 √x（x≥0）是 x^(1/2) 的非负主值，本页同时给出 ±√x 与: The square root √x (x>=0) is the non-negative principal value of x^(1/2); this page also gives ±√x and x²; for x<0 it returns the imaginary value i·√|x|, and integer inputs are additionally simplified into the radical a√b (x=a²·b).
map.√x 是满足 r²=x 的非负数 r（主值），等价于 x^(1/2)；任意 n: √x is the non-negative number r with r²=x (the principal value), equivalent to x^(1/2); the n-th root is x^(1/n). Algebraic identities: √(a·b)=√a·√b and √(a/b)=√a/√b hold only for a, b>=0; √(a+b) cannot be split into √a+√b. For x>=0 this page outputs √x, −√x and x² and self-checks with r×r≈x; for x<0 it reports undefined over the reals and i·√|x| over the complex numbers; integer inputs are additionally simplified as x=a²·b ⇒ √x=a√b (b=1 means a perfect square).
map.实数域要求 x≥0；负数结果是复数，页面会明确标注 i，不要当成实数使用。 算术: Over the reals x>=0 is required; a negative result is complex and clearly labelled i, so do not use it as a real number. The arithmetic square root is non-negative only; the equation r²=x has two solutions ±√x, and the page shows the negative root on a separate "−√x" card. Pitfall 1: √(a+b)=√a+√b - the most common incorrect expansion, disproved by a=b=1 (√2≠2). Pitfall 2: √(a·b)=√a·√b fails when a and b have opposite signs (undefined over the reals). Radical simplification applies to integer inputs only; non-integer inputs give a decimal approximation directly.
